create_localrepo: create a LocalRepo from a directory path to scan and load .th model files
get_model_localrepo: get a pre-trained model by signature from a LocalRepo with optional checksum verification
create_remoterepo: create a RemoteRepo with a dict of model signatures mapped to download URLs
get_model_remoterepo: get a pre-trained model by signature from a RemoteRepo via torch hub URL download
create_anymodelrepo: create an AnyModelRepo that combines a ModelOnlyRepo and BagOnlyRepo to resolve both single models and bags
